concentration.monetary_measure: identified qualifying gross merchandise; not accounting revenue, net sales, margin or profit
concentration.ranking_rule: customers ranked by identified qualifying gross; top ceil(10%) of customers

provenance.population: identified customers with at least one qualifying merchandise purchase in corrected V2

excluded_fields: concentration ranking tie-break description referencing customer IDs
cohort is_mature/is_cohort_entry flags (derivable from cell_status and month_index)
repeat denominator and timing-count duplicates of mature/numerator counts

excluded_source_files.signed_merchandise_sensitivity_summary.c: not needed for this page; small returns-only/negative-net counts

publication_review.suppression_rule: Dashboard display convention only: 4 post-entry cohort cells with 1-4 active customers are null here; not a disclosure guarantee because the accepted corrected-V2 Figure 2 SVG encodes the underlying values.
